question: What is social injustice?
expected_answer: Unfair treatment of people who are marginalised
answer: Social injustice is the unfair treatment of people who are considered marginalised because they have different traits, characteristics, or are less privileged than the majority (GSCS S4, p. 17). This makes them be considered unequal to other members of society (GSCS S4, p. 17). It involves a collection of shared unjust experiences affecting a group of people who are seen as inferior and expected to remain silent to the advantage of a dominant group (GSCS S4, p. 17).

question: What is the difference between leisure and sport?
expected_answer: Leisure is free time spent away from business, work, domestic chores and education
answer:
Leisure is free time spent away from business, work, domestic chores, and education, excluding necessary activities like eating and sleeping (GSCS S4, p. 33). It involves activities like entertaining friends, going on vacation, or doing hobbies (GSCS S4, p. 33). 

Sport involves all forms of competitive physical activities through casual or organised participation (GSCS S4, p. 33). Its aim is to use, maintain, or improve physical ability and skills while providing entertainment to participants (GSCS S4, p. 39).
